text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since I became
K.S.Miracle's Trainer.
Our training has been progressing
smoothly.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah... hah...!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, right!

K.S.Miracle runs at full throttle for the
sake of her wish,
regardless of the immense strain it puts on
her body.

Workouts that would be routine for any
ordinary horsegirl
can prove punishingly heavy for
K.S.Miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAH!

Truth be told,
there are moments I want nothing more than
to stop her.
Yet if I were to do that...

She would undoubtedly push herself even
harder where I couldn't see.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Her drive to run is simply too
overwhelming.
Even if the physical toll crosses into
dangerous territory...
she'll never slow down.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It's not that she "can't" stop—
she *refuses* to stop.
Do you truly understand how terrifying that
is?

...I know.
I've come to understand it all too well.
Which is precisely why I stand here now as
her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah... haah... haah...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hah... phew... T-Trainer...
My time just now shaved off a bit from the
last run, didn't it...!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I knew it...! I could feel the difference.
It feels completely different from when I
used to train alone.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad... Trainer,
I promise I'll repay your kindness on the
track!

A tender smile,
pure as that of an innocent child.
Her words and that expression make me realize
something.

Have I become one of them as well?
It wasn't a bad thing by any means,
but still...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's already time to wrap up,
isn't it?
Um, but... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Would it be okay if I ran one more lap?
I really want to hone this feeling while
it's still fresh.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness. I'm off,
then! Are you heading back ahead of me?
Please don't wait on my account—
choice_data_list: I want to watch you run, so I'll s...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
...Alright. Here I go!

...She doesn't need to include me in her
wishes.
If I can't stop her from running,
then at the very least...

I want to shoulder every other burden for
her.
If only she would simply lean on me,
and let herself be cared for—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(—I never once gave up.
But somewhere deep down...
I thought I'd never be able to find one.)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(A Trainer who would still take me on...
even after knowing the truth about my
body.)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Even so,
I was desperate...
I knew I had to find someone.
So when you praised my running,
I was overwhelmed with joy.)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(It all started out of sheer impatience and
impulsive momentum, but...)
"I want to run alongside you."
"I want to run alongside you."

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Even now,
thinking back to that moment feels like a
miracle.)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Now I have someone else I want to say "thank
you" to.
—Ah, what a...)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(What a truly blessed feeling this is.
I am so fortunate.)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, Trainer...
You're always putting so much pressure on
yourself for my sake, aren't you?)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Right now,
there's nothing I can give back to you.
Just please wait for me. One day,
I will definitely deliver it to you.)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Along with the feelings of "I'm alright"
and "Thank you"
—the words I want to share with everyone—)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I want to convey the feelings meant only
for you, Trainer.)
